description: Mechanical consistency checks over the transcribed official values. A pass means the two official figures agree with each other; it does not mean a third party audited the transcription.

checks.check: PF - PA equals published NET PTS for every team
Sum of PF equals sum of PA across the league
Sum of wins equals sum of losses
League total points on the offence page equals league PF on the standings page
League total points allowed on the defence page equals league PA on the standings page
League offence pass_yds equals league defence pass_yds allowed
League offence pass_td equals league defence pass_td allowed
League offence rush_yds equals league defence rush_yds allowed
League offence rush_td equals league defence rush_td allowed
W-L-T / PF / PA recomputed from the game archive match the official standings
Games per week look like complete NFL weeks (13-16 per week, no gaps)
Week 10 slate has 14 games and 28 distinct clubs (4 clubs on the official bye list)
Every Week 10 game has an official nfl.com game page URL
Injury report has one section for each of the 28 clubs playing in Week 10
checks.detail: club sections=28, all 28 Week 10 clubs present

checks.check: Every injury row carries the official injuries-page URL it was read from
